name: dumbbell one arm row (rack support)
description: A one-arm row with your free hand braced on a rack for support. It lets you pull heavy while keeping your back steady.
instructions: Place one hand on a rack or sturdy support and hinge forward with a flat back.
Hold a dumbbell in your other hand with your arm hanging.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip.
Squeeze your back at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
